name: Liberty Coca-Cola Beverages - Philadelphia Production Plant, PA

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords 40.006386,-75.113266 (725 E Erie Ave) confirmed. The plant is positively identified: a large Coca-Cola logo is painted on the building's NE face, and an enclosed pedestrian skybridge over the side street is Coca-Cola branded. Coca-Cola trucks and trailers fill the yard.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Multiple chain-link sliding gates along E Erie Ave control the yard - one is explicitly marked 'EXIT'. Carrier-instruction signage on the fence: 'ALL CARRIERS Park on the Street ... Check in With Guard With Paper Work ... Coiled in By Appointment ... DO NOT DOUBLE PARK'.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A fence sign explicitly reads 'GUARD SHACK - Check in Here' with a directional arrow; carriers are directed to check in with a guard. A small booth structure is visible near the gate inside the yard.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Carrier signage directs all carriers to 'Park on the Street' before check-in - the public E Erie Ave / side streets serve as pre-gate staging.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: The very large paved drop yard inside the gate functions as a post-gate holding/queue area before docks.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: A dedicated 'EXIT' gate is marked separately from the carrier check-in/entrance gate along E Erie Ave - distinct in and out points.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The drop yard is deep and very large, easily holding a queue of 3+ trucks between the gate and the dock banks.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Carrier sign explicitly warns 'DO NOT DOUBLE PARK' and directs street parking - the gate fronts a busy urban arterial (E Erie Ave) with limited stacking room, so a queue spills onto public roads.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large multi-building urban plant - the production building plus a long dock/warehouse building have extensive dock banks with dozens of trailers backed in. Banded 50+; exact count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yard packed with 100+ Coca-Cola trailers and red delivery trucks - banded 50+.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 3+ connected buildings: the main production plant, a long dock/warehouse building, and a building west of the side street linked by the Coca-Cola branded skybridge.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Multiple dock faces across the complex but a single integrated operation - could not confirm physically separate ship vs receive clusters; left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box (~420m N-S x ~390m E-W complex) ~ 14 acres - approximate.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property (rail line runs nearby but not into the yard).

citations.claim: Liberty operates production at 725 E Erie Ave, Philadelphia; HQ + a production facility serving the tri-state region

verification.rationale: Liberty Coca-Cola Beverages-operated Philadelphia production plant + HQ; Liberty runs the Philly/NY/NJ/DE Coca-Cola territory.
